description.en: The ID of the tag to be modified.

description.zh:
待修改的标签值。

- 如果需要清除该标签，则设置标签值为（$NULL$）。
- 多值请用英文逗号分割。
- 格式校验，最大长度：3000字符
description.en:
The tag value to be modified.

- To clear this tag, set the tag value to ($NULL$).
- For multiple values, use English commas to separate them.
- Format validation, maximum length: 3000 characters

description.zh: 待修改标签值的用户ID。此处的用户ID为Quick BI的UserID，而非阿里云的UID。
description.en: The user ID for which the tag value is to be modified. This user ID refers to the Quick BI UserID, not the Alibaba Cloud UID.
